title: Order files need a staff login: a member is never read as the Founder outside the admin
why: URGENT (the CEO's brief, 2026-11-26; 0165's urgent path): a signed-in member could add or replace a proof on another client's order (Access::who default). Proved on the live code (tools/access-tests/who.php): with no staff session Access::who() returned the Founder, so the order_proof and order_file upload targets (upload-targets.php's $tvOrderStaff, Access::can) let any signed-in member past the staff check for any order id; ClientOrders::canAddFiles checks only the order's state. Fixed at the cause (decisions/0109: admin access through Access::can; 0127: each target's check decides who): with no staff session who() is nobody and can() refuses ('Sign in with your staff login first'); a staff lookup that throws is nobody, never the Founder; the order targets also require a staff login. Kept, each named by a decision: a scheduled job on the command line still reads as before (its callers act on what a person approved; agents go through canAs, piece2-team.md finding 2), and an admin page during decisions/0100's switch-over (no owner's staff login yet) still opens. The audit of callers outside /admin (Work queue #51), each now refused without a staff login on the web: lib/upload-targets.php (order_proof, order_file: the hole); lib/RecordFiles.php canOrders, read by /api/stock.php (a member could list an order's files: closed too); /api/send-crawler.php and /directory/index.php (who() === founder: an admin member without a staff login sent the crawler: closed); lib/EnvSettings.php:224 (keys: the Founder's staff login, or the command line); lib/Pulse.php's case actions, Operations, ControlBoard, SystemStart, Preflight, VendorBills, ClientOrders::canRelease, StagingSite::canManage, Blocks (already asked for a staff login), Releases::can (handles the command line itself), app/ui/vault.php, outside-services.php, qb-merge.php (drawn inside the admin, where bootstrap requires a staff login). Tier 4, the CEO's Prior Ruling Check: repairs 0109 and 0127, not a rule change. Backend only.

changes.what: Adding or replacing a file on a client's order, or seeing an order's files from the Gallery, needs a staff login; a member is told to sign in with one

checks.who: tools/access-tests/who.php 12 on MariaDB, each case in its own process: on the live code a member reads as the Founder and passes order_proof and order_file (proved); fixed: a member is nobody, can() refuses with the staff-login words, both targets refuse; a Service staff login passes; a failing staff lookup is refused; a scheduled job still runs; decisions/0100's switch-over still opens an admin page, never anything outside it
